editorial:
Imagine you are part of a fancy sorority, but instead of just parties and studying, you have a crazy house mother who makes your lives a living nightmare. You and your friends decide to take matters into your own hands to get rid of her, thinking you have committed the perfect crime. However, the vibe shifts quickly from a secret pact to a total panic attack when someone starts picking you off one by one. It feels like a classic throwback to those early slasher films where the characters make bad choices and the tension keeps building in a big, spooky house.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about who the killer actually is. While some of the acting feels a bit dated, the pacing is fast enough that you will not get bored. It is a great pick if you love old-school mystery and scares. If you want the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection to see all the gritty details. It is the perfect movie to put on for a late-night marathon with friends who enjoy a good whodunit.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the house mother did not actually die during the initial attack. She survived and spent the rest of the movie hunting the girls down for revenge. In the final scenes, she reveals herself as the killer and tries to finish off the remaining sisters. After a scary showdown, the mystery is solved, and the cycle of violence finally ends with the survivor escaping the madness of the house.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s slasher films and mystery twists.
